title: I made a block puzzle game and launched it on Android with no ads at all
author: wratheyestudios

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/wratheyestudios please share some more about how you used AI in developing this. Naming the tools or saying "made with AI" doesn't count. Rule 4 is how we keep promotional posts contributing, by having them talk about the process and how the game was made. Trying to keep the sub focused on dev. This post may be removed if it isn't updated.

replies.author: wratheyestudios
replies.body: Well. Everything is made with code. No assets were used. The pipeline was simple. I used rea to see how other games in this genre do their director for pieces and reworked it in my idea with more fair play and no intrussive ads. I used claude opus 5.5 for everything.
